plan.flow: One responsive Feedlot web app. All signed-in users share the same menu, in this order: Overview → Lots → Inventory → Rations → Feeding plans → Feeding log → Lot weights → Yard summary → Feed-to-Gain. Administrators also get conditional links from Overview to Accounts, Sync, and Demo; Operators never see those links. Sign-in is email and password only, with no registration or SSO. Design guidance for DESIGN.md: use dense, readable operational tables and one contextual headline figure rather than dashboard card grids; filters apply immediately; use a plain bar, hairline separators, and restrained status color. Layouts use a centered max-width container, CSS Grid where useful, clear non-overlapping zones, and responsive tables that become labeled stacked rows on narrow screens; full-height layouts use min-h-[100dvh], never h-screen. NEVER DO: emojis; Inter; generic serif fonts such as Times New Roman, Georgia, or Garamond; pure black (#000000); neon or outer-glow shadows; oversaturated accents; excessive gradient text; custom cursors; overlapping elements; equal three-column card layouts; generic names; fake round-number stats; AI clichés; filler scroll prompts; broken Unsplash links; centered hero sections. Replace four KPI cards and sparklines with one sourced headline metric plus a dense table; replace feature-card grids with ordered records and real operational detail; replace glass or gradient surfaces with solid bordered surfaces; use icons only when they speed recognition. No marketing hero or ticketing/seat-picker patterns.

plan.sample:
Product: Feedlot, a responsive web app for cattle-feedlot operations. Local date for the sample is Apr 17, 2025; the single yard time zone is America/Denver. People: Mara Chen — Feed Operations, Administrator, mara.chen@feedlot.example; Luis Ortega — Yard Operations, Operator, luis.ortega@feedlot.example; Nia Brooks — Feed Operations, Operator, nia.brooks@feedlot.example. They have no yard space, vehicle, or license plate shown in this product. On the account directory use separate real portrait photos for Mara, Luis, and Nia; in the shared header use initials, not portraits. Yard: Pen 4 capacity 120, contains 96 head (L-241 64 and L-242 32), 24 free. Pen 7 capacity 110, contains 82 head (L-243), 28 free. Total: 178 active head, 3 active lots, 2 active pens, capacity 230, 52 free.
Procurement traceability: Prairie Creek Cattle Co. PO-5817 line 2 received Jan 8, 2025, 96 Angus head into Pen 4: L-241 64 head at $1,400/head, allocated purchase cost $89,600; L-242 32 head at $1,400/head, allocated cost $44,800. Mesa Range Livestock PO-5831 line 1 received Mar 1, 2025, 82 Hereford steers into Pen 7 as L-243, $1,460/head, allocated cost $119,720. A mock source PO-5842 line 1 has no receiving quantity and is rejected, not imported. Lots: L-241 Angus steers, received Jan 8, 782 lb average, latest Apr 16 987 lb, target 1,350 lb, 99 days on feed as of Apr 17, measured ADG 2.07 lb/day, FCR 8.69, cost of gain $1.09/lb, projected ship Oct 9, 2025. L-242 Angus heifers, received Jan 8 at 748 lb, Apr 16 931 lb, 99 days on feed, ADG 1.85, FCR 9.12, cost of gain $1.18/lb. L-243 Hereford steers, received Mar 1 at 815 lb, Apr 15 903 lb, 47 days on feed, ADG 1.87, FCR 8.76, cost of gain $1.14/lb. Aggregate weighted average ADG 1.94 lb/day and weighted average cost of gain $1.13/lb. Total feed cost across active lots $29,425.36.
Saved ration Finisher 18 is intended for 850–1,350 lb cattle: steam-flaked corn 70%, alfalfa hay 20%, cottonseed meal 7%, mineral premix 3%; crude protein 13.2%, TDN 77.4%, net energy 0.82 Mcal/lb; normalized calculated cost $0.1254/lb. Current ingredient costs for its normalized calculation are $0.11/lb corn, $0.09/lb hay, $0.25/lb cottonseed meal, and $0.43/lb mineral premix. system.digest: Panels use 8px corners, with 6px corners on fields and buttons. Panels are flat and edged by a 1px hairline rather than a shadow. Use a 4px spacing rhythm of 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, and 32px, with a 28px pause before each new section. Set first-level headings to 28px/600, second-level headings to 22px/600, third-level headings to 16px/600, and body text to 14px with relaxed leading. Table rows are 44px tall and divided by 1px horizontal rules; on narrow screens each becomes a labeled stacked record. Primary buttons are filled, secondary buttons outlined, and fields solid with a visible 2px focus edge; all controls are at least 44px high. Show each status with a small semantic dot beside plain text, never a lozenge. Crop photographs to a consistent 4:3 frame centered on the subject, reusing the same person's photograph wherever they appear. Replace boxed groups with a 28px pause and one continuous hairline beneath each section heading.

motion.signature: The contextual headline figure's real digits roll upward from translateY(0.65em) to translateY(0) over 600ms with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), staggered by 35ms on first view.
